import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 5007;
    static final long LARGE_INF = 1000000000L;
    static final long MOD_VAL = 1000000007L;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int from_node;
        int to_node;
        long max_capacity;
        long unit_cost;
        long current_flow;

        FlowEdge(int f, int t, long cap, long cst) {
            from_node = f;
            to_node = t;
            max_capacity = cap;
            unit_cost = cst;
            current_flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<FlowEdge> all_edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] shortest_path_dist = new long[MAX_N];
    static long[] potential = new long[MAX_N];
    static List<Integer>[] adjacency_list = new List[MAX_N];
    static int[] predecessor_edge = new int[MAX_N];

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c_param = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d_param = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            adjacency_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int[] vertex_demands = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int vertex = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            vertex_demands[--vertex]++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            insert_bidirectional_edge(5000, i, vertex_demands[i], 0);
        }

        for (int time_step = 0; time_step < m; time_step++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 99; layer++) {
                long edge_cost = d_param;
                for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 50; iteration++) {
                    insert_bidirectional_edge(u + layer * 50, v + (layer + 1) * 50, 1, edge_cost);
                    insert_bidirectional_edge(v + layer * 50, u + (layer + 1) * 50, 1, edge_cost);
                    edge_cost += 2 * d_param;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int layer = 0; layer <= 99; layer++) {
            insert_bidirectional_edge(0 + layer * 50, 5001, Long.MAX_VALUE, (long) c_param * layer);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 99; layer++) {
                insert_bidirectional_edge(i + layer * 50, i + (layer + 1) * 50, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }

        long[] result = min_cost_max_flow_computation(5000, 5001);
        assert result[1] == k;
        System.out.println(result[0]);
    }

    static void insert_bidirectional_edge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        adjacency_list[u].add(all_edges.size());
        all_edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, cap, cost));
        adjacency_list[v].add(all_edges.size());
        all_edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void initialize_potentials(int source, int num_nodes) {
        Arrays.fill(potential, LARGE_INF);
        potential[source] = 0;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < num_nodes; ++iter) {
            for (int idx = 0; idx < all_edges.size(); ++idx) {
                FlowEdge e = all_edges.get(idx);
                if (e.max_capacity == e.current_flow) continue;
                if (potential[e.from_node] == LARGE_INF) continue;
                potential[e.to_node] = Math.min(potential[e.to_node], potential[e.from_node] + e.unit_cost);
            }
        }
    }

    static void compute_shortest_paths(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(shortest_path_dist, LARGE_INF);
        shortest_path_dist[source] = 0;
        TreeSet<long[]> ordered_set = new TreeSet<>((a, b) -> {
            if (a[0] != b[0]) return Long.compare(a[0], b[0]);
            return Integer.compare((int) a[1], (int) b[1]);
        });
        ordered_set.add(new long[]{0, source});
        while (!ordered_set.isEmpty()) {
            long[] entry = ordered_set.first();
            long cur_dist = entry[0];
            int node = (int) entry[1];
            ordered_set.remove(entry);
            for (int edge_index : adjacency_list[node]) {
                FlowEdge e = all_edges.get(edge_index);
                if (e.max_capacity == e.current_flow) continue;
                int next_node = e.to_node;
                long adjusted_weight = e.unit_cost + potential[node] - potential[next_node];
                if (shortest_path_dist[node] + adjusted_weight < shortest_path_dist[next_node]) {
                    ordered_set.remove(new long[]{shortest_path_dist[next_node], next_node});
                    shortest_path_dist[next_node] = shortest_path_dist[node] + adjusted_weight;
                    predecessor_edge[next_node] = edge_index;
                    ordered_set.add(new long[]{shortest_path_dist[next_node], next_node});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] min_cost_max_flow_computation(int source, int sink) {
        initialize_potentials(source, 50);
        compute_shortest_paths(source);
        long total_flow = 0, total_expense = 0;
        while (shortest_path_dist[sink] != LARGE_INF) {
            long augment = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            long sum_cost = 0;
            int cursor = sink;
            while (cursor != source) {
                int idx = predecessor_edge[cursor];
                augment = Math.min(augment, all_edges.get(idx).max_capacity - all_edges.get(idx).current_flow);
                sum_cost += all_edges.get(idx).unit_cost;
                cursor = all_edges.get(idx).from_node;
            }
            total_flow += augment;
            total_expense += augment * sum_cost;
            cursor = sink;
            while (cursor != source) {
                int idx = predecessor_edge[cursor];
                all_edges.get(idx).current_flow += augment;
                all_edges.get(idx ^ 1).current_flow -= augment;
                cursor = all_edges.get(idx).from_node;
            }
            compute_shortest_paths(source);
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) potential[i] = shortest_path_dist[i];
        }
        return new long[]{total_expense, total_flow};
    }
}
